DETERMINISTIC: immutable cmd reproduces exactly -- 7 dots over '7 passed in 1.35s', internally consistent (one dot per test), same wall time as the claim. Lint gate: NOTE that `git diff --name-only HEAD -- '*.py'` is EMPTY here because all four new files are UNTRACKED, so the qa.md snippet as written would have aborted on its own empty-set guard; I derived the scope as the union with `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` (2 files), passed them via xargs (never an unquoted var), and got 'All checks passed!' exit=0 -- so Main's claim is TRUE though 'git-derived scope' is under-specified for a new-file step. Default-ruleset ruff adds SIM102 (gate_feasibility.py:37 nested if) and PLR0402 (test file:70 import alias) -- style only, outside the qa.md gate, NOTE not violation. Runtime smoke: module imports clean; preregistered_horizon()=126, measure_v_from_82_3() and required_annualized_sr(45,2883,0.008169)=0.6886 all live-reproduce their recorded values. No frontend touched (1b N/A); no UI claims (1c N/A). Unintended-change check: `git diff` touches only .claude/masterplan.json (+19 lines = exactly the disclosed 83.1.4 defect step), the researcher agent-memory, and hook-appended audit JSONLs. Zero tracked production code modified.

CRITERIA: C1 MET -- N grid {1,2,10,45,100} superset of {1,10,45,100}; four T windows (GDELT 2883 / EDGAR 6434 / GPR 10477 free, control 2011 correctly labelled free:False); 60 cells; periods_per_year=252 with T in daily obs; I re-bisected the repo function myself without importing gate_feasibility and every one of the 20 measured-V cells matched to 4dp, plus V=0.5 -> 2.0692 and V=0.167921 -> 1.4034; monotonicity verified over 400 points. q9 (falsify every value to 42.0) SURVIVES but that is criterion 1's own mandate ('none is asserted against a threshold'), not a defect. C2 MET -- function-scoped analytics attribute lookup (gate_feasibility.py:75,78) makes the spy real; m1 KILLED; q13 additionally proves the spied RESULT is load-bearing not a mere touch (perturbing the spy's variance 100x moves the output 0.6886 -> 2.51). C3 MET -- V=0.008169/n=24 re-derived independently from the 82.3 artifact (24 pooled run Sharpes, ddof=1), mean 0.5733 / min 0.3909 / max 0.8246 all exact. C4 MET -- horizon 126 read at runtime from the git-TRACKED preregistration; engine comparison computed from inspect.signature(BacktestEngine.__init__).holding_days=90 x1.5=135, which I verified independently; all four span quotients exact. C5 artifact-side MET (all 8 payloads reproduce byte-identically) but the immutable live_check field is NOT satisfied -- see violation 1. C6 MET -- kill rule 1786101901025006841 < results 1786102105820125782; ordering also holds against the broader plausible population (live_check, experiment_results); I independently confirmed K1's 0.8246 IS the measured max in the 82.3 artifact, K4's 45 IS the prereg trial_budget_cap, and PromotionGate.max_pbo reads 0.2 at runtime -- the kill-rule thresholds are sourced, not invented. C7 MET -- test_c7 mutates the REAL file and calls the same helper test_c6 calls (extraction-for-testability per qa.md 4c#7, not a re-implementation); I verified after all 16 of my mutants that the kill-rule mtime is byte-identical to the original.

LOWER-SEVERITY (not blocking, for the fix pass): (a) q5 -- dropping a candidate source from span_counts.per_source SURVIVES; the source SET is not pinned, though all four are in fact recorded. (b) `_step_result_artifacts()` (test:146-147) is a hand-typed one-element list rather than a derived glob -- the phase-75 hand-derived-scope shape; it survives here only because the ordering holds under the broader population too, and the non-empty assert blocks the vacuous-empty case. (c) The C6/C7 mtime mechanism is vacuous on a fresh clone (git does not preserve mtimes; the test docstring acknowledges 'equal passes'), but criterion 6 mandates mtime explicitly, so this is criterion-imposed, not an author choice -- worth one disclosure line in experiment_results. (d) Scoped regression run `-k "analytic or pbo or dsr or deflat or gate or phase_83 or backtest"` = 6 failed / 299 passed; I classified all 6 as PRE-EXISTING and unrelated -- none of the three failing files contains any reference to gate_feasibility / 83_1_1 / killrule_phase83, and the price-tolerance failures are driven by live environment state (kill switch PAUSED, pause_reason='manual'). Not attributable to this step, but experiment_results does not mention them.

BOUNDED SCOPE OF THE FIX -- the arithmetic is sound and should not be reworked: regenerate the live_check PBO block from the artifact, correct the two ranges in experiment_results:39 and live_check:47, correct gate_feasibility.py:178-182's reading_note and re-run run_all(), and add the reading_note-vs-payloads consistency assertion that mutants q7/q8 show is missing.

EVIDENCE-PROVENANCE DISCLOSURE: I took every measurement in this verdict myself (independent re-derivation, verbatim payload reproduction, and a 16-mutant matrix run via stdin against scratch copies outside the repo). No file in the repo was written or modified by me; the qa-write-guard hook correctly blocked my one attempt to write a mutation runner into the scratchpad, and I used a heredoc instead. One planned check did not complete: an exhaustive sweep of seeds 1-12 x S in {8,16,32} to prove no configuration reproduces 0.5982672759713673 timed out at 7 minutes. The finding does not rest on it -- numpy default_rng is deterministic, I reproduced all 8 recorded payloads exactly from the module's own seeding, and the float occurs in exactly one file repo-wide.
